notes.title: Compatible with the Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Downware has successfully passed our compatibility tests and is now Steam Deck Compatible. You can now enjoy your Downware experience on the go, directly on your Steam Deck!

[h2]Key Compatibility Highlights[/h2]
[h3]Controls[/h3]
– Fully remapped interface for the gamepad

[h3]Performance[/h3]
– Stable 90 FPS at 720p on Steam Deck
– Graphics options optimized for battery life
– Added Vulkan API

[h3]Display & HUD[/h3]
– Text size and readability adjusted for the 7″ screen

[h3]Steam Deck Features[/h3]
– Quick-action shortcut support
– Steam Overlay open with no performance impact
– Cloud save support



*We are waiting for Steam verification

notes.title: Downware – Available !
notes.notes:
Get ready for an unforgettable experience! Downware, our brand-new first-person Cyberpunk horror game, plunges you into a dark and oppressive world.

Where is Lucy? Your girlfriend has mysteriously vanished, and the truth lies hidden behind intricate puzzles, heart-pounding chase sequences, and a building laden with deadly traps. Under the relentless watch of Mark-13, a cyborg enforcer of martial law, every decision is crucial to escape a grim fate.

Experience immersive gameplay, authentic settings, and a chilling atmosphere that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Mark your calendars for April, and prepare to explore a realm where mystery meets horror, and every corner hides a secret.

Get ready… Horror awaits!

notes.notes:

or via our [url=https://discord.com/invite/YE5T9hv6UQ]Discord[/url].

Thank you in advance for your help and curiosity!

notes.title: The Final Stretch!
notes.notes:
The development of Downware has entered its final phase !
We are now channeling all our efforts into refining the finer details and hunting down any last-minute bugs that could impact your gameplay. Every tweak is essential to deliver a seamless and captivating adventure.

To amaze you with the storytelling and immersion, we've filmed an impressive 20 minutes of cinematic sequences. These scenes will deepen the narrative and draw you further into the unique world of Downware.

[previewyoutube=7czWgjKzpMo;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=l8E93kxAWzg;full][/previewyoutube]

As for the release date, we’re aiming for a launch within the first or second quarter of 2025. We can't wait to share this adventure with you and deeply appreciate the patience and support of our wonderful community throughout this journey.
